remarks: In Norwalk's Spring Hill neighborhood, A truly unique and well maintained legal two-family property offering space, flexibility, and incredible potential. Property features include a 2022 roof and hardwood floors throughout, including under the carpeting in two rooms. The main living area offers a primary en suite and 1,638 sq. ft. on the first floor. The finished lower level adds 840 sq. ft. with a half bath and kitchenette area, offering additional usable space and flexibility. The upper level features a legal 1-bedroom, 1-bath apartment with its own private entrance. Solid, spacious property, and full of possibilities! Being sold in as-is condition.
